The CAMO Underwater Hockey club held its fourth annual edition of the summer tournament at the outdoor pool of the [Aquatic Complex](https://www.facebook.com/events/1995925431292976/?utm_source=gemini) at Parc Jean-Drapeau.

### Overview and Results

* **Weather:** Teams enjoyed sunny skies for most of the day, but the tournament had to be cut short due to thunderstorms rolling in around the outdoor pool.
* **Standings:** With Mother Nature forcing an early conclusion to the matches, the final standings were determined based on tournament standings before the inclement weather.
* **Champions:** Congratulations to the Cornwall Underwater Hockey team for their victory in this 2026 edition!

Thank you to all the players for their enthusiasm and team spirit throughout the event.
